clue.text: Make a disc to be the world's best seller

definitions.meaning: to cut a new gramophone disc is to make a recording of music

definitions.text: to be the world's best seller
definitions.meaning: to outsell everyone ever is to set an unbeaten mark for sales

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses play on the phrase: recording music onto vinyl, and setting an all-time high mark that nobody has beaten.

clue.text: A sharp blow on the left side evokes sympathy

parts.note: a rap is a sharp knock or blow
port is the left-hand side of a ship

explanation.surface: A slap on someone's left side somehow stirs fellow feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapport is a close, understanding relationship, which is a kind of mutual sympathy.

clue.text: At work above everything else

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: Someone busy at their job outdoes everybody.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sitting on the very top of a heap lies higher than all the rest.

clue.text: The fourteenth letter to loved one will 15

definitions.note: the cross-reference stands for the answer to 15 Down, the verb bewitch

parts.note: the fourteenth letter of the alphabet is N, spelt out as en
an amour is a lover or sweetheart

explanation.surface: A letter written to a sweetheart is meant to win them over.
explanation.walkthrough: '15' points to the answer at 15 Down, CHARM, used as a verb; 'will' only links it to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To captivate someone and make them fall in love is to bewitch them.

clue.text: Income tax returns

parts.note: not the forms filed each year but money sent back to the taxpayer by the authorities

explanation.surface: A heading about the yearly forms sent in to the tax office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Returns' looks like the annual forms a taxpayer files; here it means money coming back to them.
explanation.definitionFit: Repayments of overpaid tax are refunds, money handed back to the payer.

clue.text: Piece of evidence used in a crossword

definitions.meaning: a detective's lead, an item pointing towards the culprit
each line of a puzzle that hints at an entry

explanation.definitionFit: A detective's lead and a puzzle's hint both point the solver towards an answer.

clue.text: Somewhat cross initially with the composer

indicators.note: Somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone is a little annoyed with a musician at first.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'with'; it is only a link joining the wordplay to 'the composer', which alone names the Italian opera writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Gioachino Rossini was the Italian who wrote the opera The Barber of Seville.

clue.text: New moat, perfectly round and airy

indicators.note: a new version of the word moat is a fresh arrangement of its letters

parts.note: a perfectly round object is spherical, shaped like a ball

explanation.surface: A freshly dug ditch encircles a castle, open to the breeze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' looks like a shape for the moat, but 'perfectly round' is a separate piece, and 'New' is the signal to rework the moat's letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Atmospherical means relating to the air around the earth, so it is a fancy word for airy.

clue.text: Showing growing talent in the nursery despite an inexperienced touch

definitions.text: Showing growing talent in the nursery despite an inexperienced touch

parts.words: Showing growing talent in the nursery despite an inexperienced touch
parts.note: the nursery is a plant nursery, not a children's room, and the inexperienced touch is a novice's colour-coded hand

explanation.surface: A child in a playroom shows early promise though still raw.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nursery' suggests small children; it is a garden nursery, and 'growing talent' is a gift for growing plants. 'Inexperienced' hints at the first half, green meaning raw.
explanation.definitionFit: A person good at gardening is said to have a natural gift for making plants thrive.

clue.text: Coati Pa disturbed obtaining starchy substance from a plant

indicators.note: disturbed letters are thrown out of their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: A coati and its father are upset at getting a starch out of a plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' rearranges the letters of COATI PA.
explanation.definitionFit: Tapioca is a starch extracted from the root of the cassava plant.

clue.text: Prize-fighter, one who inflicts injuries

definitions.meaning: a person who leaves bruises on others

explanation.definitionFit: A brawny boxer is a tough guy, and also literally one who leaves marks on people.

clue.text: Empty order for a musical instrument

annotationWithheld.why: 'Empty order for a musical instrument': O inside OBE, but 'Empty' must give O and also signal putting it inside the order; no other word signals the container, so one word does two jobs
annotationWithheld.clue: Empty order for a musical instrument

clue.text: Heard number being played loudly

indicators.note: heard says the word is to be taken by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: forty is a number

explanation.surface: A tune is heard being performed at full volume.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heard' makes FORTY, said in a British accent with no R, sound like the musical term; 'being' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Forte is the Italian musical direction to perform with strength and volume.

clue.text: Zero energy of long distance runner

parts.note: nil means zero, nothing
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: A marathon athlete has no energy left at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runner' suggests an athlete, but it is a river that runs a very long way.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nile is one of the longest rivers in the world, flowing over 6,000 km.

clue.text: Bewitch church member

parts.note: an arm is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: A congregation member casts a spell on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To charm is to enchant or cast a spell over someone.

clue.text: Race in which one does not do all therunning

definitions.text: Race in which one does not do all therunning

parts.words: Race in which one does not do all therunning
parts.note: a contest in which each team member covers only one leg before handing over

explanation.surface: A competition in which nobody has to do all the work.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue as held runs 'the running' together.
explanation.definitionFit: In a relay, teammates take turns, each passing a baton to the next runner.

clue.text: Vessel without stabilisers

definitions.meaning: a ship with no stabilisers rocks fore and aft in a swell, so it is one that pitches

explanation.definitionFit: A jug for water is one sense; an unstabilised ship tossing nose to tail in waves is the other.

clue.text: He has the star part in a western

definitions.text: He has the star part in a western

parts.words: He has the star part in a western
parts.note: not the lead actor but the lawman who wears a star-shaped badge in a cowboy film

explanation.surface: An actor lands the lead role in a cowboy film.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Star part' suggests the lead role; it is the man whose part of the costume is a tin star badge.
explanation.definitionFit: In westerns the lawman of a county wears a star-shaped badge of office.

clue.text: Monarch had more trouble through his heart

indicators.note: going through his heart means being placed in the middle of the other letters
to trouble a word is to stir its letters up into a new order

parts.note: per means through or by way of

explanation.surface: A king suffered further troubles that struck him to the core.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trouble' rearranges MORE to EMOR, and 'his heart' puts PER in its middle; 'had' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: An emperor is a sovereign ruler of an empire, a supreme monarch.

clue.text: Last letter from Cornish resort for atonement

indicators.note: from here means taken away from the town's name

parts.note: Penzance is a seaside town in Cornwall, south-west England
Z is the last letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: A final note posted from a Cornish holiday town makes amends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' takes Z out of PENZANCE, a resort in Cornwall, the county at England's south-west tip.
explanation.definitionFit: Penance is a punishment taken on willingly to make amends for wrongdoing.

clue.text: In the game this might be scored by canon hesitantly

definitions.text: In the game this might be scored

parts.note: a canon is a musical round, a song in staggered parts
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A churchman hesitantly scores a point in a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'canon' suggests a clergyman; it is a musical round. The game is rounders, a British bat-and-ball game like baseball, where a run is called a rounder.
explanation.definitionFit: In rounders a player who runs round all four posts scores a point of that name.

clue.text: Late Greek god, expressionless

parts.note: late means deceased, dead
Pan is the Greek god of the wild and shepherds

explanation.surface: A Greek deity, now departed, shows no emotion.
explanation.definitionFit: A deadpan face shows no feeling at all, especially when joking.

clue.text: I am not sure if I am one

definitions.text: I am not sure if I am one

parts.words: I am not sure if I am one
parts.note: a speaker uncertain even about their own uncertainty, so they fit the description they question

explanation.surface: Someone muses that they cannot be certain about what they are.
explanation.definitionFit: A sceptic is someone uncertain, so being unsure whether you are one proves it.

clue.text: Guide dog?

definitions.meaning: an indicator or tip that shows the way
a gun dog breed that stands still facing the game

explanation.definitionFit: A hint or needle shows direction, and a breed of gun dog shows hunters where game lies.

clue.text: Hotels in opposite directions

parts.note: north and south are opposite compass points, N and S

explanation.surface: Lodgings face different ways.
explanation.definitionFit: An inn is a small hotel or pub offering rooms to travellers.

clue.text: Criticise severely and be deeply afflicted

definitions.meaning: to slate or savage something in a review
to be very distressed or upset

explanation.definitionFit: A reviewer can savage a book, and a person can be badly upset; both use the phrasal verb.

clue.text: Bird might be found at the end ofthe line

definitions.meaning: a bird of prey, a type of hawk

definitions.text: might be found at the end ofthe line
definitions.meaning: a toy flown on a long string

explanation.definitionFit: A kite is a hawk-like bird of prey, and also a paper toy flown on a string.

clue.text: Former sex-appeal is way out

parts.note: ex means former
it is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: Lost attractiveness is no longer fashionable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'way out' could mean trendy; here it is a door to leave by.
explanation.definitionFit: An exit is a door or passage by which one leaves.

clue.text: Thought to be material

definitions.meaning: past tense of feel, to believe

explanation.definitionFit: The past tense of feel means believed, and the noun is a pressed woollen cloth.

clue.text: Attached to girl by River Dee

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name
the Exe is a river in Devon
dee is the spelt-out name of the letter D

explanation.surface: Fastened to a young woman beside a Welsh river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'River Dee' looks like one river; it splits into River (the EXE, in Devon) and Dee, the name of the letter D; 'by' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: To annex is to join or append something, so attached means added on.

clue.text: It holds matinees possibly at three

indicators.note: possibly says the letters could form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: Afternoon shows are put on at three o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: A playhouse stages afternoon performances, called matinees.

clue.text: They correspond

parts.note: not things that match but people who exchange messages by post

explanation.surface: Two things match.
explanation.definitionFit: People who exchange postal mail are correspondents.
